provenance.task_mapping: Only non-board domains mapped to reject; no claim original labels are FPGA intents.

protocol.existing80_192_288: Observed development only; never training gradient
protocol.heldout: Synthetic unseen wrapper families + official MASSIVE test partition; final single first evaluation, not independent-human blind data
protocol.selection: validation raw correct, reject falseaccept; original80>=73,192>=129,observed288>=218; no user25/99/163 for training or selection
protocol.architecture: Frozen production Unicode Engram six-way encoder plus a learned signed Unicode1..4gram sparse INT8 binary context head (1024 bins,2056 constant bytes,threshold64); hierarchical neural reject-logit fusion. Initial intent6+executable2 residual trials were rejected, not the selected architecture.
protocol.group_split_limits: New synthetic wrapper families are separated; their parameter draw intervals differ, but older replay training already includes some same numerical values. This is not a globally parameter-disjoint or speaker-disjoint evaluation. Shared tool names and base action cores are intentional.
protocol.first_evaluation_frozen: heldout_first_evaluation.json is immutable after its first pass. Any later policy fixes replay its discovered failures as observed regression; no further checkpoint/threshold selection uses it.
protocol.runtime_order: Run the learned binary context head once before every business schema fast path. Its precomputed result is reused if the full encoder is required; it is not run twice. A learned context deny has priority over read-only schema rescue. Shared tool execution contracts still validate capability,parameter and receipt.
protocol.fusion: When context deny-minus-allow margin>=64, joint reject=max(encoder reject,max encoder nonreject+margin-64+1). Otherwise encoder scores are unchanged. Context,encoder and joint logits are reported separately and are not calibrated probabilities.
protocol.policy_vs_neural: Later fixes for context-deny rescue override,same-tool sequential actions and external temperature scope affect system admission only; they do not change the frozen neural checkpoint,threshold or first-evaluation neural results.
